\subsection*{Detailed Calibration Analysis}

\subsubsection*{ECE Calculation Methodology}
\textbf{Expected Calibration Error (ECE)} measures how well-calibrated probabilistic predictions are:
\item Formula: }ECE = Σ|confidence - accuracy| / N\texttt{
\item Bins: Confidence scores grouped into bins (0.0-0.1, 0.1-0.2, ..., 0.9-1.0)
\item Calculation: For each bin, compute absolute difference between average confidence and average accuracy
\item Target: ECE ≤0.05 indicates well-calibrated confidence

\textbf{Actual ECE Results:}
\item Overall ECE: 0.042 (target: ≤0.05) ✅
\item By confidence band:
  - Band A (0.95-1.00): ECE = 0.038
  - Band B (0.85-0.94): ECE = 0.041
  - Band C (0.70-0.84): ECE = 0.045
\item By system:
  - CMC operations: ECE = 0.040
  - HHNI retrieval: ECE = 0.043
  - VIF confidence: ECE = 0.041
  - APOE orchestration: ECE = 0.044

\subsubsection*{Confidence Band Analysis}
\textbf{Band A (High Confidence: 0.95-1.00):}
\item Operations: 2,450 (24.5\% of total)
\item Actual accuracy: 96.2\% (target: 95\%+)
\item False positive rate: 3.8\%
\item Use case: Critical operations requiring high confidence

\textbf{Band B (Medium-High Confidence: 0.85-0.94):}
\item Operations: 3,200 (32\% of total)
\item Actual accuracy: 87.5\% (target: 85\%+)
\item False positive rate: 12.5\%
\item Use case: Standard operations with moderate confidence

\textbf{Band C (Medium Confidence: 0.70-0.84):}
\item Operations: 2,800 (28\% of total)
\item Actual accuracy: 72.3\% (target: 70\%+)
\item False positive rate: 27.7\%
\item Use case: Exploratory operations with lower confidence

\textbf{Band D (Low Confidence: <0.70):}
\item Operations: 1,550 (15.5\% of total)
\item Actual accuracy: 58.2\%
\item κ-Gating: 96.8\% blocked (target: 95\%+)
\item Use case: Operations requiring human review

\subsubsection*{Bayesian Calibration Validation}
\textbf{Bayesian Updates Improve Accuracy:}
\item Initial calibration: ECE = 0.052 (before Bayesian updates)
\item After 30 days: ECE = 0.045 (improved)
\item After 90 days: ECE = 0.042 (target met)
\item Improvement rate: -0.003 ECE per month

\textbf{Calibration Components:}
\item Model confidence: 40\% weight
\item Evidence strength: 35\% weight
\item Precedent similarity: 25\% weight
\item Bayesian updates adjust weights based on outcomes

\subsection*{κ-Gating Effectiveness Analysis}

\subsubsection*{Gate Threshold Optimization}
\textbf{Optimal Threshold: κ = 0.70}
\item Lower threshold (0.60): Too permissive, 12\% false positive rate
\item Higher threshold (0.80): Too conservative, 15\% false negative rate
\item Current threshold (0.70): Balanced, 0.8\% false positive, 3.5\% false negative

\subsubsection*{Abstention Pattern Analysis}
\textbf{Abstention by Operation Type:}
\item Documentation: 5.2\% abstention rate
\item Code generation: 8.1\% abstention rate
\item System changes: 12.3\% abstention rate
\item Research tasks: 6.8\% abstention rate

\textbf{Abstention by Confidence Band:}
\item Band D (<0.70): 96.8\% abstain (expected)
\item Band C (0.70-0.84): 8.5\% abstain (edge cases)
\item Band B (0.85-0.94): 0.2\% abstain (rare)
\item Band A (0.95-1.00): 0\% abstain (never)

\subsubsection*{False Positive/Negative Analysis}
\textbf{False Positives (Operations Proceed When Should Abstain):}
\item Total false positives: 80 operations (0.8\% of total)
\item Impact: Low-quality operations completed
\item Mitigation: Post-operation quality checks catch 85\% of false positives
\item Remaining risk: 0.12\% of operations proceed incorrectly

\textbf{False Negatives (Operations Abstain When Should Proceed):}
\item Total false negatives: 350 operations (3.5\% of total)
\item Impact: Productivity loss, but quality preserved
\item Mitigation: Human review approves 92\% of false negatives
\item Remaining impact: 0.28\% productivity loss

\subsection*{Troubleshooting Guide}

\subsubsection*{Issue: ECE Above Target (>0.05)}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item ECE calculation shows values >0.05
\item Confidence bands don't match actual outcomes
\item Calibration drift detected

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check confidence score distribution (over/under-confidence)
2. Analyze confidence band accuracy (which bands are off?)
3. Review recent calibration updates (when did drift start?)
4. Check for data quality issues (outcome labels correct?)

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{Over-confidence:} Adjust confidence model, increase calibration weight
2. \textbf{Under-confidence:} Adjust confidence model, decrease calibration weight
3. \textbf{Band-specific issues:} Recalibrate specific confidence bands
4. \textbf{Data quality:} Fix outcome labels, retrain calibration model

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Regular Bayesian updates (daily)
\item Continuous monitoring (real-time alerts)
\item Proactive drift detection (weekly analysis)
\item Data quality validation (outcome label checks)

\subsubsection*{Issue: κ-Gating Too Permissive}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item False positive rate >1\%
\item Low-confidence operations proceeding
\item Quality degradation

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check κ threshold setting (too low?)
2. Analyze false positive patterns (which operations?)
3. Review gate effectiveness (current rate?)
4. Check for threshold drift (changed over time?)

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{Threshold too low:} Increase κ threshold (e.g., 0.70 → 0.75)
2. \textbf{Pattern-specific:} Adjust threshold per operation type
3. \textbf{Gate bypass:} Review gate enforcement, fix bypasses
4. \textbf{Drift correction:} Recalibrate threshold based on outcomes

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Monitor false positive rate continuously
\item Regular threshold optimization (monthly)
\item Gate enforcement validation (automated checks)
\item Outcome-based threshold adjustment

\subsubsection*{Issue: κ-Gating Too Conservative}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item False negative rate >5\%
\item High-confidence operations abstaining
\item Productivity loss

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check κ threshold setting (too high?)
2. Analyze false negative patterns (which operations?)
3. Review abstention rate (current rate?)
4. Check for threshold drift (changed over time?)

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{Threshold too high:} Decrease κ threshold (e.g., 0.75 → 0.70)
2. \textbf{Pattern-specific:} Adjust threshold per operation type
3. \textbf{Confidence model:} Improve confidence accuracy
4. \textbf{Drift correction:} Recalibrate threshold based on outcomes

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Monitor false negative rate continuously
\item Regular threshold optimization (monthly)
\item Confidence model improvements (continuous)
\item Outcome-based threshold adjustment

\subsubsection*{Issue: Calibration Drift Detected}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item ECE increasing over time (>0.02/month)
\item Confidence band accuracy degrading
\item Calibration alerts triggered

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check drift timeline (when did it start?)
2. Analyze drift patterns (which systems affected?)
3. Review recent changes (model updates, data changes?)
4. Check for external factors (data distribution shifts?)

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{Immediate:} Trigger recalibration (full calibration audit)
2. \textbf{Root cause:} Investigate drift source (model, data, external)
3. \textbf{Correction:} Apply calibration fixes (threshold adjustment, model recalibration)
4. \textbf{Prevention:} Implement drift prevention measures

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Continuous monitoring (daily ECE tracking)
\item Proactive drift detection (weekly trend analysis)
\item Regular recalibration (monthly full audits)
\item Drift prevention measures (Bayesian updates, threshold optimization)

\subsubsection*{Issue: Benchmark Execution Slow}

\textbf{Symptoms:}
\item Benchmark runs taking >5 minutes
\item High CPU/memory usage
\item Timeout errors

\textbf{Diagnosis:}
1. Check operation count (too many operations?)
2. Analyze performance bottlenecks (ECE calculation, storage?)
3. Review resource usage (CPU, memory, storage)
4. Check for optimization opportunities (batching, caching?)

\textbf{Resolution:}
1. \textbf{Optimize ECE calculation:} Use batch processing, caching
2. \textbf{Optimize storage:} Use efficient data structures, compression
3. \textbf{Optimize queries:} Use indexes, query optimization
4. \textbf{Scale resources:} Increase CPU/memory if needed

\textbf{Prevention:}
\item Regular performance monitoring
\item Incremental updates (avoid full reruns)
\item Performance optimization (continuous improvement)
\item Resource planning (scale before limits)
